name: Google Drive
description: Resolves Google Drive files, shared links and Workspace exports through the official Drive API.

account.secret_hint: Nothing to paste here. Google Drive is signed in through Google itself: enter your OAuth client ID above, start the sign-in, and agree in the browser window that opens.
account.username_hint: Google Drive needs an OAuth client of your own — this project ships none, so that every installation has its own Google quota. In the Google Cloud Console create a project, enable the Google Drive API, then under Credentials create an OAuth client ID of type Desktop app, add http://127.0.0.1:8710/api/v1/oauth/callback as an authorised redirect URI, and paste the client ID here. Nothing is pasted into the secret field: the sign-in fills it.
